meta_title: Reading Challenge Tracker for iPhone | BookWorm
meta_desc: Set a yearly reading challenge and watch each finished book land on your shelf. BookWorm builds it from a daily goal and shows whether you're on pace.
og_title: Your reading challenge, one book on the shelf at a time
og_desc: A yearly book goal built from a daily habit, with a shelf that fills as you finish.
h1: Your year in books, one spine at a time.
lede: A reading challenge works when it's built from days, not from a big number in January. Choose what you can read each day, and BookWorm shows the books it adds up to.
shot_alt: Profile with a 16-day current streak, an 18-day best and reading stats.
shot2_alt: Reading Quests in BookWorm: 36 of 30 pages today, goal reached, and a 16-day streak.
points_lede: One daily habit underneath, one shelf on top.
p1_d: Pick pages or minutes a day. BookWorm turns it into a number of books for the year, so the target matches a day you can actually keep.
p2_d: Every book you finish this year stands on your shelf as a spine, next to empty places for the ones still to come.
p3_d: A gold flag marks where today's pace says you should be. Ahead of it, behind it, or right on it, you see it at a glance.
p4_d: Paper books, ebooks and audiobooks all count toward the same challenge. Listening on a walk is reading.
table_title: How many pages a day for your challenge
table_intro: For books of about 300 pages, read every day of the year:
table_note: At about 1.5 minutes a page. Your numbers will differ: the calculator works them out for your own books and speed.
q1: How many books should I aim for this year?
a1: Start from the time you have. Fifteen minutes a day is about a book a month for most readers. If last year was six books, twelve is a real stretch. The challenge ideas guide has more ways to choose.
a2: Nothing breaks. The flag shows where your pace is, and the goal is yours to change. Plenty of readers catch up in summer or on holiday.
q3: Do audiobooks count toward a reading challenge?
a3: In BookWorm they do. Minutes of listening count toward the same daily goal as pages, and a finished audiobook takes its place on the shelf.
a4: You can share each finished book as a library checkout card, and on the first of each month BookWorm shows a recap of the month you read.
